offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) - Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage. Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens. Token packs: Prototype Development $50 / 0.050-1M tokens; Production Deployment $500 / 0.045-1M tokens.
offerings.price_basis: Prototype Development 档 (0.050-1M tokens), 每次搜索固定消耗 10,000 tokens 起步, 机械换算 10,000×0.00005=$0.50/次
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.note: search the web and return the top five results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text. w/ Free API Key 100 RPM, w/ Premium API Key 1000 RPM, 平均延迟 2.5s。Premium 档 0.045-1M tokens 时换算 $450/1k 次。
